subject: DI04000251

h.en: 2.1.1 First find the section that can fail

body.en:
Start with the situation

A pin may shear, a thin eye may tear, and a contact surface may crush even when the rod itself is strong.

Definition / principle

Direct-stress design compares load with the correctly identified resisting area and allowable stress.

Understand why

Capacity is area×allowable stress for the stated failure; the smallest relevant capacity governs.

Application / illustration

A joint is a chain of components, not just one diameter calculation.

Common mistake / conditions

Projected bearing area is not the curved contact surface area; single and double shear count actual interfaces.

Does double shear mean double load?

No. The same transmitted load is resisted at two shear planes.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Rod મજબૂત હોવા છતાં pin shear,thin eye tear,contact surface crush થઈ શકે.

Definition / Principle

Direct-stress designમાં loadને correct resisting area,allowable stress સાથે compare કરીએ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Stated failure માટે capacity=area×allowable stress;relevant capacitiesમાંથી સૌથી નાની governing બને.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Joint અનેક componentsની chain છે,ફક્ત એક diameterની ગણતરી નહિ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Projected bearing area curved surface area નથી;single/double shearમાં actual interfaces ગણો.

Double Shear એટલે Double Load?

ના.Same transmitted loadને બે shear planes resist કરે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Label the plane and force direction before selecting an equation.

Understand why

Round rod in axial tension:A=pi d²/4.Plate with one transverse hole:Anet=(w−dh)t.

Pin in single shear:A=pi dp²/4; double shear:A=2pi dp²/4 when both planes carry the total load.

Pin/plate bearing uses projected area dp t; two identical fork lugs use2dp tf.

Edge shear-out uses the actual ligament length from hole edge, not blindly the hole-centre edge distance.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Equation પહેલાં plane,force direction label કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Axial round rod A=pi d²/4;એક transverse holeવાળી plate Anet=(w−dh)t.

Single-shear pin A=pi dp²/4;double shear A=2pi dp²/4 જ્યારે બન્ને planes total load લે.

Pin/plate bearing projected area dp t;બે identical fork lugsમાં2dp tf.

Edge shear-outમાં hole edgeથી actual ligament લો;hole-centre edge distance અંધપણે નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

P24kN, plate w50mm, t8mm, hole dh18mm, pin dp16mm; allowables tension100, shear70, bearing160MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Net tensile stress=24000/[(50−18)×8]=93.75MPa
  2. Double-shear pin stress=24000/[2pi×16²/4]=59.6831MPa
  3. Single plate bearing=24000/(16×8)=187.5MPa

Common mistake / conditions

Tension and pin shear pass, but bearing fails. This trial must be revised; passing two checks does not approve the joint.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

P24kN,plate w50mm,t8mm,hole dh18mm,pin dp16mm;allowables tension100,shear70,bearing160MPa.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Net tensile stress=24000/[(50−18)×8]=93.75MPa
  2. Double-shear pin stress=24000/[2pi×16²/4]=59.6831MPa
  3. Single plate bearing=24000/(16×8)=187.5MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Tension,pin shear pass થાય,પણ bearing fail થાય.Trial સુધારવો પડે;બે checks pass એટલે joint approved નહિ.

h.en: 2.2.1 Knuckle joint:function, parts and force path

body.en:
Definition / principle

An eye fits between fork lugs and a transverse pin allows limited angular motion while transferring axial load.

Understand why

The two rods, one single eye, one fork, pin, pin head and approved retention form the joint.

Rod force enters one member, passes by bearing into the pin, and leaves through the other member.

Applications include suitable tension links and tie connections; compressive use needs buckling and alignment checks.

Allowable stresses for rod, pin and lug may differ; state them rather than assuming one material value for all.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Eye fork lugs વચ્ચે fit થાય;transverse pin limited angular motion સાથે axial load transfer કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

બે rods,single eye,fork,pin,pin head,approved retention joint બનાવે.

Rod force એક memberથી bearing દ્વારા pinમાં,પછી બીજા memberમાં જાય.

Suitable tension links,tie connectionsમાં ઉપયોગ;compressionમાં buckling,alignment જુઓ.

Rod,pin,lugના allowables જુદાં હોઈ શકે;એક value બધાં માટે ન માનો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Begin with rod tension and pin double shear, then check pin bending using a defined contact model.

Understand why

Rod:d≥sqrt(4P/(pi sigma t)).Pin shear:dp≥sqrt(2P/(pi tau)).

For eye thicknesst and each fork thicknesst1, a common model uses uniform eye loading and triangular fork reactions.

In that model Mmax=(P/2)(t/4+t1/3); pin bending stress=32Mmax/(pi dp³).

Size from all criteria; changing t or t1 changes the pin bending check as well as bearing area.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

પહેલાં rod tension,pin double shear;પછી defined contact modelથી pin bending જુઓ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Rod d≥sqrt(4P/(pi sigma t));pin shear dp≥sqrt(2P/(pi tau)).

Eye thickness t,દરેક fork thickness t1 માટે common modelમાં uniform eye load,triangular fork reaction લો.

આ modelમાં Mmax=(P/2)(t/4+t1/3);pin bending stress=32Mmax/(pi dp³).

બધા criteriaથી size લો;t,t1 બદલાય તો bearing area સાથે pin bending પણ બદલાય.

body.en:
Definition / principle

LetDe be the outside width across the pin hole; use actual chosen dimensions.

Understand why

Eye bearing:P/(dp t); two-fork bearing:P/(2dp t1).

Eye net tension:P/[(De−dp)t]; fork net tension:P/[2(De−dp)t1] for the stated simplified profile.

For end ligamenta from hole edge, eye shear-out area2at; two forks give4at1.

Head/retainer, clearance, wear and articulation are separate details; an empirical head size is not proof against every service load.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Pin holeની બહારની width De લો;actual selected dimensions વાપરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Eye bearing P/(dp t);two-fork bearing P/(2dp t1).

Stated simplified profileમાં eye net tension P/[(De−dp)t];fork P/[2(De−dp)t1].

Hole edgeથી end ligament a હોય તો eye shear-out area2at;બે forksમાં4at1.

Head/retainer,clearance,wear,articulation અલગ details;empirical head size દરેક service loadનો proof નથી.

body.en:
Given and model

P40kN; allowable tension/bending80, shear50, bearing120MPa. Steady-load teaching model.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Rod dmin=sqrt(4×40000/(pi×80))=25.2313mm; select30mm
  2. Pin shear dpmin=sqrt(2×40000/(pi×50))=22.5676mm
  3. Choose eye t25mm, each fork t1=15mm, trial pin32mm, outside width De70mm
  4. Mmax=(40000/2)(25/4+15/3)=225000Nmm
  5. Pin bending stress=32×225000/(pi×32³)=69.9411MPa

Common mistake / conditions

32mm pin is governed more strongly by bending than its simple double-shear minimum; complete the remaining checks.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

P40kN;allowable tension/bending80,shear50,bearing120MPa.Steady-load teaching model.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Rod dmin=sqrt(4×40000/(pi×80))=25.2313mm;select30mm
  2. Pin shear dpmin=sqrt(2×40000/(pi×50))=22.5676mm
  3. Choose eye t25mm,each fork t1=15mm,trial pin32mm,outside width De70mm
  4. Mmax=(40000/2)(25/4+15/3)=225000Nmm
  5. Pin bending stress=32×225000/(pi×32³)=69.9411MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

32mm pin માટે simple double-shear કરતાં bending વધુ governing છે;બાકીના checks પૂર્ણ કરો.

body.en:
Given and model

Use P40kN, d30, dp32, t25, t1=15, De70mm; round profile end ligamenta=(70−32)/2=19mm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Rod tension=40000/(pi×30²/4)=56.5884MPa
  2. Pin double shear=40000/(2pi×32²/4)=24.8680MPa
  3. Eye bearing=40000/(32×25)=50MPa; fork bearing=40000/(2×32×15)=41.6667MPa
  4. Eye net tension=40000/[(70−32)×25]=42.1053MPa
  5. Fork net tension=40000/[2(70−32)×15]=35.0877MPa
  6. Eye shear-out=40000/(2×19×25)=42.1053MPa; fork shear-out=40000/(4×19×15)=35.0877MPa

Common mistake / conditions

These nominal checks and the preceding pin-bending check pass their supplied allowables; retention, wear, fatigue and detailed geometry remain outside this simplified verification.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

P40kN,d30,dp32,t25,t1=15,De70mm;round profileમાં a=(70−32)/2=19mm.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Rod tension=40000/(pi×30²/4)=56.5884MPa
  2. Pin double shear=40000/(2pi×32²/4)=24.8680MPa
  3. Eye bearing=40000/(32×25)=50MPa;fork bearing=40000/(2×32×15)=41.6667MPa
  4. Eye net tension=40000/[(70−32)×25]=42.1053MPa
  5. Fork net tension=40000/[2(70−32)×15]=35.0877MPa
  6. Eye shear-out=40000/(2×19×25)=42.1053MPa;fork shear-out=40000/(4×19×15)=35.0877MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ nominal checks,અગાઉનું pin bending given allowablesમાં pass થાય;retention,wear,fatigue,detailed geometry simplified verification બહાર છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A shallow transverse wedge secures a spigot inside a socket to connect coaxial rods under axial load.

Understand why

Parts include rod ends, socket, spigot, matching slots, cotter and appropriate collars/shoulders.

The axial force transfers through shoulder/contact and cotter-bearing paths according to load direction and construction.

The taper facilitates assembly/tightening; friction, retention and service vibration must be reviewed, not assumed from taper alone.

A cotter connects axial-force members; keys and couplings normally transmit shaft torque. Do not interchange their design equations.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Shallow transverse wedge socketમાં spigot secure કરીને coaxial rodsને axial load માટે જોડે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Rod ends,socket,spigot,matching slots,cotter,appropriate collars/shoulders parts છે.

Load direction,construction મુજબ axial force shoulder/contact,cotter-bearing pathsથી transfer થાય.

Taper assembly/tighteningમાં મદદ કરે;friction,retention,vibration તપાસો,ફક્ત taperથી safe ન માનો.

Cotter axial-force members જોડે;keys,couplings shaft torque આપે.Equations interchange ન કરો.

h.en: 2.3.2 Cotter failure areas and design sequence
h.gu: 2.3.2 Cotter Failure Areas અને Design Sequence

body.en:
Definition / principle

Use d for rod, ds for spigot diameter, D for socket outside diameter, t for cotter thickness andb for its breadth.

Understand why

Rod tension usespi d²/4; spigot across slot usespi ds²/4−ds t.

Socket net tension usespi(D²−ds²)/4−(D−ds)t in the stated projected-slot approximation.

Cotter double shear area2bt; spigot bearing area ds t; socket bearing area(D−ds)t.

Check cotter bending, collar bearing/shear and end shear-out too; enlarging one part may change another failure mode.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Rod d,spigot diameter ds,socket outside diameter D,cotter thickness t,breadth b લો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Rod tensionમાં pi d²/4;slot સામે spigotમાં pi ds²/4−ds t.

Projected-slot approximationમાં socket net area pi(D²−ds²)/4−(D−ds)t.

Cotter double shear area2bt;spigot bearing ds t;socket bearing(D−ds)t.

Cotter bending,collar bearing/shear,end shear-out પણ જુઓ;એક part મોટો કરતાં બીજો failure બદલાય.

h.en: 2.3.3 Cotter numerical:rod, slots, shear and bearing

body.en:
Given and model

P30kN; allowable tension/bending80, shear50, bearing120MPa. Trial d25, ds36, D70, t10, b50mm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Rod stress=30000/(pi×25²/4)=61.1155MPa
  2. Spigot net area=pi×36²/4−36×10=657.8760mm²; stress=45.6013MPa
  3. Socket net area=pi(70²−36²)/4−(70−36)10=2490.5750mm²; stress=12.0454MPa
  4. Cotter shear=30000/(2×50×10)=30MPa
  5. Spigot bearing=30000/(36×10)=83.3333MPa; socket bearing=30000/[(70−36)10]=88.2353MPa

Common mistake / conditions

All listed checks pass supplied allowables; the next card checks bending and collars rather than treating this as complete.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

P30kN;allowable tension/bending80,shear50,bearing120MPa.Trial d25,ds36,D70,t10,b50mm.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Rod stress=30000/(pi×25²/4)=61.1155MPa
  2. Spigot net area=pi×36²/4−36×10=657.8760mm²;stress=45.6013MPa
  3. Socket net area=pi(70²−36²)/4−(70−36)10=2490.5750mm²;stress=12.0454MPa
  4. Cotter shear=30000/(2×50×10)=30MPa
  5. Spigot bearing=30000/(36×10)=83.3333MPa;socket bearing=30000/[(70−36)10]=88.2353MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Listed checks pass થાય;આગળ bending,collars check કરીશું,અહીં complete નહિ.

h.en: 2.3.4 Cotter bending, collars and end ligaments

body.en:
Given and model

Use preceding layout. Assume symmetric uniform socket bearing over outer segments and uniform spigot load over the centre; cotter spanD70mm. Z=t b²/6.

Step-by-step solution

  1. For this model Mmax=PD/8=30000×70/8=262500Nmm
  2. Cotter bending stress=6M/(t b²)=6×262500/(10×50²)=63MPa
  3. Spigot collar OD50, thickness8mm:annular bearing stress=30000/[pi(50²−36²)/4]=31.7252MPa
  4. Collar shear=30000/(pi×36×8)=33.1573MPa
  5. For end ligament18mm:spigot shear-out=30000/(2×36×18)=23.1481MPa
  6. Socket end shear-out=30000/[2(70−36)18]=24.5098MPa

Common mistake / conditions

The bending formula follows the specified distribution; other pressure models give different moments. Socket shoulder/collar geometry, retention, fillets and fit require a finished drawing and additional checks.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

અગાઉનું layout લો.Outer segments પર symmetric uniform socket bearing,centre પર uniform spigot load;span D70mm,Z=t b²/6.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. For this model Mmax=PD/8=30000×70/8=262500Nmm
  2. Cotter bending stress=6M/(t b²)=6×262500/(10×50²)=63MPa
  3. Spigot collar OD50,thickness8mm:annular bearing stress=30000/[pi(50²−36²)/4]=31.7252MPa
  4. Collar shear=30000/(pi×36×8)=33.1573MPa
  5. For end ligament18mm:spigot shear-out=30000/(2×36×18)=23.1481MPa
  6. Socket end shear-out=30000/[2(70−36)18]=24.5098MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Bending formula specified distribution માટે છે;બીજા modelsમાં moment જુદું.Socket shoulder/collar,retention,fillets,fit માટે final drawing,additional checks જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given and model

For the precedingP30kN joint, provide a socket collarOD90mm at socketOD70mm, collar thickness10mm; allowable bearing120, shear50MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Collar annular area=pi(90²−70²)/4=2513.2741mm²
  2. Collar bearing=30000/2513.2741=11.9366MPa
  3. Collar cylindrical shear=30000/(pi×70×10)=13.6419MPa

Common mistake / conditions

The specified collar checks pass. The shoulder must actually contact the mating member in the chosen load direction; an unused collar is not an alternative load path.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

અગાઉના P30kN jointમાં socket OD70mm પર collar OD90mm,thickness10mm લો;bearing allowable120,shear50MPa.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Collar annular area=pi(90²−70²)/4=2513.2741mm²
  2. Collar bearing=30000/2513.2741=11.9366MPa
  3. Collar cylindrical shear=30000/(pi×70×10)=13.6419MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Specified collar checks pass.Chosen load directionમાં shoulder mating memberને ખરેખર contact કરતો હોવો જોઈએ;unused collar alternative load path નથી.

h.en: 2.3.6 Why empirical proportions are only a starting point

body.en:
Definition / principle

A memorised ratio is not a failure calculation.

Understand why

Use proportions to propose compatible pin, eye, fork, socket or cotter dimensions.

Calculate actual areas and stresses after rounding; do not present an unchecked copied proportion as a designed joint.

Check geometric consistency:hole edge ligament, outside width, slot extent and collar contact must fit the same drawing.

Identify incomplete checks honestly; fatigue, wear, buckling and assembly need suitable additional analysis when applicable.

Can knuckle pin double shear alone prove the joint safe?

No. Check bending, bearing, net tension, shear-out and service details.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

યાદ કરેલો ratio failure calculation નથી.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Proportionsથી compatible pin,eye,fork,socket,cotter dimensions propose કરો.

Rounding પછી actual areas,stresses ગણો;unchecked copied proportionને designed joint ન કહો.

Hole-edge ligament,outside width,slot extent,collar contact એક જ drawingમાં fit થાય તે જુઓ.

Incomplete checks સ્પષ્ટ લખો;applicable fatigue,wear,buckling,assembly માટે additional analysis જોઈએ.

ફક્ત Knuckle Pin Double Shearથી Joint Safe સાબિત?

ના.Bending,bearing,net tension,shear-out,service details પણ જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Rivets permanently clamp plates; lap and butt arrangements have different load paths.

Understand why

Lap joints overlap plates; butt joints meet main plate edges and use single/double cover straps.

Single, double, triple riveting describe rows; chain/staggered describe row arrangement.

Pitchp is centre distance along a row; transverse pitch separates rows; edge distance is from hole centre to plate edge.

Use hole diameterdh for net plate area and actual design rivet diameterdr for shear/bearing per the stated convention.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Rivets platesને permanently જોડે;lap,buttમાં load paths જુદાં.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Lapમાં plates overlap;buttમાં main edges મળે,single/double cover straps હોય.

Single,double,triple riveting rows બતાવે;chain/staggered row arrangement બતાવે.

Pitch p rowમાં centre distance;transverse pitch rows વચ્ચે;edge distance hole centreથી plate edge.

Net plateમાં hole diameter dh,shear/bearingમાં stated convention મુજબ design rivet diameter dr લો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Elementary joint strength is the least of tearing, shear and bearing capacities on a consistent pitch basis.

Understand why

One-hole net plate tearing:Pt=(p−dh)t sigma t. Solid plate strength per pitch=p t sigma t.

Rivet shear:Ps=n z(pi dr²/4)tau, wherez counts effective shear planes andn counts load-sharing rivets on the selected load-transfer side.

Bearing:Pc=n dr tgoverning sigma c; cover/main thicknesses must be checked separately.

Efficiency=minimum relevant joint capacity/(solid plate capacity); also check edge shear-out and any diagonal tearing paths.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Same pitch basisમાં tearing,shear,bearing capacitiesમાંથી least elementary strength છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

One-hole net tearing Pt=(p−dh)t sigma t;solid plate strength p t sigma t.

Ps=n z(pi dr²/4)tau;z effective shear planes,n selected sideના load-sharing rivets.

Bearing Pc=n dr tgoverning sigma c;cover/main thickness અલગ તપાસો.

Efficiency=minimum relevant joint capacity/solid plate capacity;edge shear-out,diagonal tearing paths પણ જુઓ.

body.en:
Given and model

One rivet per pitch:p60, t8, dr16, dh18mm; allowables sigma t100, tau70, sigma c140MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Plate tearing=(60−18)×8×100=33600N
  2. Single shear=pi×16²/4×70=14074.335N
  3. Bearing=16×8×140=17920N
  4. Joint strength=14074.335N; solid plate=60×8×100=48000N
  5. Efficiency=14074.335/48000×100=29.3215%

Common mistake / conditions

With edge-centre distance24mm, the net ligament is24−18/2=15mm; edge shear-out capacity2×15×8×70=16800N, so rivet shear still governs.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Pitchદીઠ એક rivet:p60,t8,dr16,dh18mm;allowables sigma t100,tau70,sigma c140MPa.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Plate tearing=(60−18)×8×100=33600N
  2. Single shear=pi×16²/4×70=14074.335N
  3. Bearing=16×8×140=17920N
  4. Joint strength=14074.335N;solid plate=60×8×100=48000N
  5. Efficiency=14074.335/48000×100=29.3215%

Common Mistake / શરતો

Edge-centre distance24mmમાં net ligament24−18/2=15mm;edge shear-out2×15×8×70=16800N,એટલે rivet shear governing.

body.en:
Given and model

Use same main plate, pitch and rivet data; one rivet per pitch on EACH side of butt, two covers6mm each, ideal double shear.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Shear capacity on one load-transfer side=2×pi×16²/4×70=28148.670N
  2. Main-plate bearing=16×8×140=17920N
  3. Combined cover bearing=2×16×6×140=26880N
  4. Main net tearing=33600N; combined cover net tearing=2(60−18)×6×100=50400N
  5. Governing listed capacity=17920N; efficiency=17920/48000×100=37.3333%

Common mistake / conditions

Both sides transmit the same force in series; do not add their capacities. Edge/stagger paths, cover bending and real double-shear factors require the specified design method.

Is contact curved area the bearing area here?

No. The elementary bearing check uses projected area.

આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Same main plate,pitch,rivet data;buttની દરેક side પર pitchદીઠ એક rivet,બે covers6mmદરેક,ideal double shear.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Shear capacity on one load-transfer side=2×pi×16²/4×70=28148.670N
  2. Main-plate bearing=16×8×140=17920N
  3. Combined cover bearing=2×16×6×140=26880N
  4. Main net tearing=33600N;combined cover net tearing=2(60−18)×6×100=50400N
  5. Governing listed capacity=17920N;efficiency=17920/48000×100=37.3333%

Common Mistake / શરતો

બન્ને sides same force seriesમાં transfer કરે;capacities ઉમેરશો નહિ.Edge/stagger paths,cover bending,real double-shear factors specified methodથી જુઓ.
